content.title: Options plays to navigate Fed cut rates and year-end volatility
content.description:
As US stocks (^DJI, ^IXIC, ^GSPC) continue to navigate volatility at 2025's year-end tied to the Federal Reserve's latest decision to cut interest rates, how can investors play the options trade on these themes?

Explosive Options technical analyst Bob Lang explains to Josh Lipton how one can reduce their volatility exposure through options plays, including his own calls on Citigroup (C) and Victoria's Secret (VSCO).

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Asking for a Trend.
